Deadline April 15, 2026 is the deadline to file and pay taxes . File for free File your taxes for free online with IRS Free File. Or file in person if you qualify . How to file: step by step Follow these steps to file your taxes . Extension Get an extension to October 15 to file your taxes. Pay by the April deadline to avoid penalties and interest. You may have more time to file if you were affected by a disaster situation . Your account Get your tax records, get an IP PIN and make a payment. Sign in or set up your account . Tax records and transcripts Get your tax records and transcripts . Identity protection PIN (IP PIN) Protect yourself from tax-related identity theft. Get an IP PIN . Forms Search all forms and instructions. Taxpayer identification number (TIN) To file federal taxes, you need a taxpayer identification number (TIN) . Life events Employment, marriage and divorce, family size, retirement, disasters and other life events can affect your taxes . After you file Check your refund Estimate your tax withholding Amend or fix a tax return If you got an IRS notice or letter Get help filing Get help online, by phone or in person.
